ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Extrac32 Alternate Data Stream Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Extract data from cab file and hide it in an alternate data stream

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*extrac32\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cab.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(":[^\]"))
